title: Create projects and remove members
responsibility: Authorize a source repository for a new project or let an owner remove a project member.

inputs.name: createProject.deps
inputs.description: Persistence, repository authorization and optional clock.

inputs.name: createProject.actor
inputs.description: Verified actor who becomes the new project owner.

inputs.name: createProject.input
inputs.description: Trimmed project name of 1–200 characters and a positive repository ID.

inputs.name: removeMember.deps
inputs.description: Persistence used for the membership transaction.

inputs.name: removeMember.input
inputs.description: Project UUID and member actor ID.

outputs.name: createProject
outputs.description: Promise of the created project with owner role and committed collaboration revision.

outputs.name: removeMember
outputs.description: Removes the member and project invitations for that email; resolves without a value.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Rejects invalid input, repository authorization failures, denied membership, missing members, removal of the last owner or exhausted write retries.
